description: E002 firefighters action has conflicting figures: BX1 headline says 200, BX1 body describes about 50 at first plus arrivals, and Brussels Times reports a delegation. Final unique attendance is not reconciled.
required_followup: Find a contemporary source establishing whether at least 50 distinct participants attended.

description: E004 Ostend report combines strike participants and demonstrators in an approximately 400 figure. The distinct public-gathering count is unknown.
required_followup: Find source separating workers who struck from people who attended the public action.

description: E008 VRT’s 70–80 estimate is a pre-event forecast; BRUZZ confirms a gathering but reports no realized turnout.
required_followup: Find post-event attendance evidence for the gathering outside Groen headquarters.

description: E009 Belga confirms farmers and tractors at the N-VA reception entrance but does not give participant attendance; the party reports thousands of its own members inside.
required_followup: Find a contemporary count of people protesting outside, kept distinct from tractors and party-reception attendees.

description: A Stuut title announces a 12 January Sourour commemoration, while VICE reports a gathering on 15 January. The Stuut page timed out before its contents could be read; occurrence and relationship remain unresolved.
required_followup: Establish whether a separate 12 January gathering occurred and whether it meets attendance and domestic-state-target criteria; do not merge dates without evidence.

description: The exact AP care-sector article is under an inherited AP manual hold confirmed by the parent. No body or AP-written copy was requested. This is historical access evidence, not a fresh target-specific AP denial in this run.
required_followup: No retry or AP copy request in this run; coordinator may retain the saved restriction and source gap.

description: Q028’s exact HLN search response reported a robots.txt block. The Ostend report attributes its 400 combined strike/protest figure to HLN, but no HLN article or alternate host was opened.
required_followup: Keep the robots restriction; use permitted independent sources if further verification is needed.

description: Technical retrieval failures left BIPMedia, DeWereldMorgen, L-Post, the BRUZZ firefighters/police pages, RTBF and the Observatoire event page unread. DNS/cache/internal failures are not denials; observed 403 responses for BRUZZ firefighters and De Standaard are recorded separately.
required_followup: Do not retry pages with observed 403 or timeout; consider only permitted sources and retain technical versus denial distinctions.

description: The 22 January Vandecasteele rally demanded release by Iran while also asking Belgian officials to exert pressure. Inclusion assumes the explicit demand to Belgian officials meets the domestic state-policy target criterion.
required_followup: Coordinator review of domestic state-target interpretation.

description: Physical ending dates and post-event continuity were not established for the January candidates; no end date is inferred from last publication, scheduled speeches or month boundary.
required_followup: For each retained candidate, seek direct evidence of physical end and evidence before/after the month for continuity or duplication.

description: State response variables and protester violence remain unknown unless an event-specific response is explicitly reported. A custody death is not coded as violence at the later Sourour gathering; unassigned “bangs” are not attributed.
required_followup: Only update response or violence fields with event-specific source evidence; preserve unknown elsewhere.

description: Searches surfaced a Gent budget protest headline (HLN/PZC) but the event date is unverified and search metadata suggests it may be outside January 2023. It remains a search-only lead, not a candidate.
required_followup: Verify the exact date from an accessible permitted source before assigning the event to any month.

description: BRUZZ’s 31 January report credits Belga; related Belga and some syndicated pages do not constitute separate independent counts. Other source relationships remain unverified unless stated.
required_followup: Coordinator should verify origin chains before treating reports as independent corroboration.

description: Current official baseline, full country-month universe and reuse terms remain unverified; the consulted 2015 manual refers to an additional Coding Procedure that was unavailable. Open-web searches cannot reproduce LexisNexis or support an exhaustive absence claim.
required_followup: Coordinator review against the official baseline and any current supplementary coding instructions when available.
